description: This source file contains partial struct implementations for serializing and deserializing field headers within the Orleans.Serialization framework, including methods for writing and reading headers in a wire protocol format.

classes.name: Writer< TBufferWriter >
classes.description: A partial struct providing serialization methods for writing field headers in a wire format.

classes.name: FieldHeaderCodec
classes.description: A static class providing methods for reading field headers from a wire format, including extended headers and type information.

methods.name: WriteFieldHeader
methods.description: Writes the header for a field including its ID, expected and actual types, and wire type.

methods.name: WriteFieldHeaderExpected
methods.description: Writes a simplified expected field header based on field ID and wire type.

methods.name: ReadFieldHeader
methods.description: Reads a field header from the wire, including extended header data if necessary.

methods.name: ReadFieldHeader
methods.description: Returns a Field object representing the header read from the wire.

methods.name: ReadExtendedFieldHeader
methods.description: Reads extended header data, including potentially reading a type if schema type indicates.

methods.name: ReadType
methods.description: Reads type information based on schema type (well-known, encoded, referenced).

methods.name: ReadTypeForAnalysis
methods.description: Reads type information for diagnostic or analysis purposes.

methods.name: ReadFieldHeaderForAnalysis
methods.description: Reads a field header for diagnostic purposes, including analysis of type information.
